Subject: Recap from today's call — billing path & invoice requirements

Maya,

Thanks again for the demo and the walkthrough this morning. Quick recap from our side and a short list of asks so AP can confirm the procurement path:

Summary:
- We're interested in a Dedicated + Hosted hybrid for the pilot (security + cost balance).
- Primary procurement route will be our corporate purchase order (PO).
- Finance prefers a single invoice per month, with the PO number on the invoice and PDF delivered to AP email.

AP / billing asks:
- Do you accept a PO (we usually use Net 60; is Net 60 supported or do you require Net 30?)
- Do you support purchasing via AWS Marketplace (we sometimes prefer that route to simplify procurement)
- What invoice format do you need (line-item detail, tax/VAT fields, billing address)?
- Please share Redwood's billing address, tax ID/EIN, and a sample invoice so our AP team can validate match to our systems.
- Our AP contact: ap@nimbushealth.com (CC'd); billing address below.

Attachments: Nimbus_PO_Template_2026.pdf (our PO template)

Billing address:
Nimbus Health Inc.
Accounts Payable
1200 Harbor Blvd, Suite 500
Oakland, CA 94607
Tax/VAT: US entity (no VAT)

Next steps: If you can confirm the above or provide the sample invoice and any additional onboarding docs, we'll route to AP and expect to issue a PO early next week.

Lisa — thanks for the clear recap and the PO template. Great to meet you today.

Quick answers and what we'll provide:
- PO vs card: We accept customer-issued POs for invoicing. Our standard payment term is Net 30; Net 60 is possible but requires approval from Finance (see Karthik on CC).
- Marketplace: We are listed on AWS Marketplace (billing via the marketplace is supported for some product tiers). For Dedicated contracts we typically do direct invoicing — if you prefer marketplace we can check eligibility for the pilot and confirm any fee differences.
- Invoice format: We can produce a single PDF invoice per month containing PO number, line-item detail (model/instance usage), subtotal, any applicable taxes, and Redwood's tax/EIN fields. Sample invoice attached.
- Billing address & tax ID: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  220 Meridian Ave, Suite 400
  Palo Alto, CA 94301
  EIN: 94-1234567

I've attached: Redwood_W9.pdf and Redwood_Sample_Invoice.pdf (sample shows the PO number field and line items).

Action items from my side:
- Ben / Sales: confirm flexible terms approval (Ben)
- Karthik / Finance: confirm Net 60 approval path and any required credit docs (Karthik)

If you want, we can send a draft invoice with a mock PO number so your AP can confirm acceptance before you issue the live PO.

Best,

Hi all — looping Finance into the thread. A couple of clarifying items so Finance can confirm Net 60: 

1) Please have the customer include the PO number on the PO PDF and in the invoice subject line when they submit AP requests.
2) We need the legal entity name (exact match to tax docs). Maya provided Redwood's EIN already.
3) If customer is US entity with no VAT, we will leave VAT fields blank. If they're EU/foreign, we require a VAT number.
4) Please send the PO to ap@redwoodinference.com and CC your procurement contact so we can tie to the deal.

If the PO amount is above $150k run-rate, we will need a credit review (we can fast-track for pilots). Otherwise Finance can approve Net 60 for this pilot.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Finance Operations
